name: open-pr
description: Open a pull request that reads like the repo's own maintainers wrote it: contribution rules and PR template via `ccx vcs guidelines`, house style scouted from a bot-filtered sample of recent human-authored merged PRs, register calibrated against a local wlm voice profile, a politeness and standards-conformance pass on repos you do not own, shipped through `ccx vcs ship`, and a background watcher that clears mechanical CI and bot failures. Use when opening, submitting, or contributing a PR, or when iterating one to green.
